expectedResponse.note: seam returns void. approve places the style at the level and lists it (a new StyleRow by the creator's handle, on, record entry); return sends it back with the reason as notes. Approve is disabled in the UI when rights.confirmed is false; already decided is not_allowed

actions.evidence: POST /v1/admin/styles/review/:id/decide { decision: approve | return, level?, reason }. approve places the style at a level and lists it; return sends it back to the creator with the reason as notes.
